info.description:
Collection rieng cho cac test case Boundary Value Analysis (BVA) thuoc Task QLPT-281 (nguoi phu trach: Hien) - Sprint 4, gom 2 Subtask: [QLPT-286](https://hientm0978.atlassian.net/browse/QLPT-286) BVA so dien thoai (users.phone / addresses.phone) va [QLPT-287](https://hientm0978.atlassian.net/browse/QLPT-287) BVA ma OTP (do dai + het han).

## Chay nhanh
1. Backend chay local tai `http://localhost:8081`, DB da co seed data (`database/seed.sql`).
2. Import collection nay (da tu chua bien can thiet, khong can Environment rieng).
3. Chay `00 - Setup` truoc (lay access_token cho nhom 02).
4. Chay lan luot `01`, `02`, `03`. Cac case trong `03` co tien to `MANUAL-` can thao tac tay (xem console log server de lay ma OTP that, dat bien `runManualOtpCases=true`).
5. Sau khi kiem tra xong nhom `02`, co the chay `99 - Optional Cleanup` (dat `runCleanup=true`) de xoa cac address test, tranh vuot qua gioi han 5 dia chi/user.

## Phat hien quan trong da ap dung vao test case (xem chi tiet trong Claude Project, doc Sprint4-BVA-Testing.md muc 6)
- Rang buoc `users.phone` la REGEX `^(0[3|5|7|8|9])+([0-9]{8})$` qua `/auth/send-otp`, KHONG phai do dai 1-15.
- Rang buoc `addresses.phone` la REGEX KHAC: `^(0|\+84)[0-9]{8,10}$`, bien la so chu so SAU TIEN TO (8-10).
- `otp_verifications.otp_code` khong co @Size, luon so sanh bang gia tri that (equals) - case 'sai do dai' thuc chat la 'sai gia tri'.
- Dau `+` trong regex send-otp co the cho phep lap nhom dau so - xem case `PHONE-REG-BUG-01` (nghi van bug).
